quality_rule: Veto a frozen-B0-admitted reference if predicted mask area / box area < 0.45 OR finite predicted presence < 0.65
visible_oracle: Veto only actually reviewed VISIBLY_UNUSABLE observation keys; UNKNOWN allows B0
quota_control: SHA256 rank of B0-admitted keys, same total veto count as visible oracle; offline-only quota diagnostic
visual_selection: Prediction-only contact-risk ranking, max 48 per split, 45-frame per-public spacing
GT_policy: Freeze prediction inputs, quality labels, code, and branch predictions first; independent score reads exposed development/validation only
scientific_promotion_requirements: All attached RQ0 section 7 requirements; no threshold changes or new branches for performance search
